knowledge_retrieval_unavailable.consequence: All five generators were instructed NOT to call the server and NOT to read its silence as evidence of novelty, and to screen by direct reading. Four generators additionally opened primary abstracts via WebFetch (provenance retrieved, abstract-level only, verified_by naming the task). scientific_boundary: This snapshot commit archives the filed IDEA records byte-for-byte as PROPOSALS ONLY. Proposals are not hypotheses, are not approved, and are not evidence. No hypothesis (H-*), experiment (EXP-*), evidence (EV-*) or decision (DEC-*) record is created by this commit and no status of anything changes; approval is /design-experiment under Coordinator authority. Every filed record reports sota_delta +0 on the time exponent against its named baseline; no record claims an attack, speedup, novelty above unverified, closure, or breakthrough in any direction. Generator-enumerated closures are the generators' claims, reviewed by nobody, and are not adopted by this archive.
self_neutrality: The receipt cannot embed its own final hash, size, commit SHA or parent SHA. Those remain null; every other declared path is hashed from its final pre-commit bytes under content_first.
